roadmaps.title: DataWeave from zero
roadmaps.summary: Your first transformation to confident everyday DataWeave.

steps.title: Your first transformation
steps.lesson: A DataWeave script has a **header** (`%dw 2.0`, `output ...`) and a **body** after `---`. The body is one expression whose value becomes the output. `payload` is the input.

quiz.prompt: What separates the header from the body of a script?
quiz.explanation: Three dashes on their own line end the header.

steps.title: Arrays: map and filter
steps.lesson: `map` transforms every element (`$` is the item, `$$` its index); `filter` keeps the elements whose condition is true.

steps.title: Objects and selectors
steps.lesson: Read fields with `.key`, every match with `.*key`, descendants with `..key`. Build objects with `{ key: value }`, merge them with `++`, transform pairs with `mapObject`.

steps.title: reduce, groupBy and pluck
steps.lesson: `reduce` folds an array into one value (give the accumulator a start value); `groupBy` buckets items by a key; `pluck` turns an object into an array.

quiz.explanation: `sizeOf` counts characters in a string or elements in an array.

steps.title: Read errors, fix bugs
steps.lesson: Most failures are precedence (`==` binds tighter than `mod`), nulls (use `default`), type mismatches (a function given an array instead of a string), or a `reduce` without a start value. The Debugging Arena drills each one.

roadmaps.title: Integration developer
roadmaps.summary: The transformations real integrations need: XML, nested payloads and reshaping.

steps.title: Reshape payloads
steps.lesson: Most integration work is reshaping: pick fields, rename keys, nest and un-nest. Combine selectors with `map` and object construction.

steps.title: XML in and out
steps.lesson: Read attributes with `.@name`, repeated elements with `.*item`, and set `output application/xml`. XML needs a single root element.

steps.title: Filter and sort records
steps.lesson: `filter` by condition, `orderBy` by a key (it sorts ascending), and `distinctBy` to de-duplicate.

steps.title: Aggregate
steps.lesson: Totals with `reduce` or `sum`, buckets with `groupBy`, counts with `sizeOf`.

steps.title: Handle messy input
steps.lesson: Real payloads have missing fields and wrong types. Guard with `default`, `is` checks and `if/else`; the Debugging Arena shows what breaks.

roadmaps.title: Interview preparation
roadmaps.summary: The patterns technical screens ask for, then timed practice.

steps.title: Array patterns
steps.lesson: Map, filter, reduce, flatten, distinct: most screening questions are a pipeline of these.

steps.title: Object patterns
steps.lesson: Merge, rename keys, pluck to arrays and back, and dynamic keys with `(key): value`.

steps.title: String patterns
steps.lesson: Split, join, case, replace and interpolation.

steps.title: Timed practice
steps.lesson: Take an Interview mode session (/interview) to practise under the clock, then review what you missed.
